sections.voiceover: Marvel Television launched VisionQuest on Disney+ with 2 episodes.

On Tuesday, October 13, Marvel Television premiered VisionQuest on Disney+. WandaVision began this trilogy in 2021 before Agatha All Along continued it in 2024. Where does VisionQuest take Paul Bettany next?
b_roll: Agatha All Along title card from 2024

sections.voiceover: Paul Bettany reprises his role, but James Spader joins the trilogy's end.
b_roll: Close up of Paul Bettany as Vision

sections.voiceover: VisionQuest concludes the epic trilogy for Marvel Television. Disney+ streams the series starting with 2 episodes on October 13. Paul Bettany returns alongside James Spader.
b_roll: Cast photos of Paul Bettany and James Spader

sections.voiceover: Stream VisionQuest on Disney+ to finish the trilogy.
